messages:
maria: Heads-up — starting planning for a per-tenant weighted-degrade rollout for high-latency/regulatory regions. Need product+eng+ops alignment on gates, opt-ins, and rollback ladder. Posting a quick draft of the plan below.

alex: SGTM. can you clarify goals? is this about cost reduction, latency targets, or availability tradeoffs?

maria: Primary goal = keep tail latency under SLA while preserving correctness for high-value tenants. Secondary = reduce token cost when overloaded. Tertiary = allow enterprise opt-outs.

sam: For SRE: we need concrete signal thresholds. propose: 95th latency > 1.2x baseline for >5m OR p50 error-rate spike > 0.5% -> trigger partial degrade. Also add region-level concurrency cap so we don't degrade entire region.

jess: From CS: enterprise customers must be able to opt-in/opt-out at tenant level. They want an explicit rollback SLA (we commit to roll back within 30m for P1). Also need clear notification text for customers.

alex: Rollout plan idea: staged canary + A/B test. Phases: 0) shadow for 24h (no user impact) 1) 1% weighted degrade (tenant slice) for 2h 2) 5% for 6h 3) 20% for 24h 4) ramp to policy. Each step gated by telemetry checks.

maria: nice. add: per-tenant opt-in list for early adopters; and a customer-exempt flag TTL. Also require a hard kill-switch scoped to org or region.

sam: Agree. We should limit blast radius: max 5% of requests per region by default, override only with exec approval. Add auto-fallback to a lower-quality model variant (quantized) if degrade fails.

alex: Implementation sketch (feature flag config snippet):
```yaml
flag: per-tenant-weighted-degrade
scope: tenant,region
stages:
  - name: shadow
    weight: 0
    duration: 24h
  - name: canary
    weight: 1%
    duration: 2h
    gate: latency_95_pctl < 1.2x AND error_rate < 0.5%
  - name: ramp
    weight: 5%
    duration: 6h
    gate: stable
fallback_policy:
  - try: model_variant: "redwood-small-quant"
  - else: route: host-fallback-pool
kill_switch: { scope: org, manual: true }
```

jess: We need wording for comms: "We will start light experiments with a small subset of tenants to verify latency and availability improvements. Enterprise tenants can opt out via support." Keep it short.

maria: +1. Also add metrics dashboard: per-tenant 95/99 latencies, token cost delta, correctness regressions (QA eval set). Hook alerts to runbook.

sam: Runbook sketch: 1) Alert fires -> oncall ACKs -> check dashboard & logs. 2) If >threshold, flip kill-switch (org scope) -> monitor for 15m. 3) If not stable, rollback model variant and revert routing. 4) Notify CS + affected customers. 5) Postmortem within 72h.

alex: Quick question: how do we handle A/B measurement for quality? we should run a small eval harness on sampled requests to compare outputs before committing ramp.

maria: yes — run parallel evals in shadow mode and surface mismatch rate. gate if mismatch > 1% for critical prompts.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled flag-service change (branch: per-tenant-degrade) queued — expected deploy window 03/24 02:00 UTC. CI: green. :white_check_mark:

jess: Action items: 1) product write customer comms blurb (maria) 2) eng (alex) to add flag + telemetry gates 3) sRE (sam) to author runbook + define alert thresholds 4) CS (jess) to compile opt-out process and contract language.

maria: I'll draft comms + add to the rollout doc. tagging ppl: @alex @sam @jess — can you each drop PR/links here by EOD tomorrow?

alex: Will do. PR by EOD.

sam: I'll share runbook draft and PagerDuty tweaks tomorrow morning.

jess: I'll draft CS opt-out flow and sample email language.

maria: thanks all. we'll reconvene after PRs. :rocket:
